criteria.description: Store the bounded record model: UTF-8 key, opaque bytes, global revision, and optional UTC expiry.
criteria.evidence: go test ./gapdb ./internal/engine ./tests/contract/api -count=1; approved WP01/WP03 review evidence
criteria.notes: Production paths, contract tests, and deletion-sensitive review probes passed.

criteria.description: Get returns an exact live record or stable not-found without entering the mutation queue.
criteria.notes: The reference profile also exercised eight concurrent socket readers.

criteria.description: Put creates or replaces a record and returns its commit revision.
criteria.notes: Verified through engine, Unix protocol, and portable adoption paths.

criteria.description: PutIfAbsent commits only when no live record exists and otherwise reports the existing revision.
criteria.notes: Conditional failure and expiry boundaries are covered.

criteria.description: CompareAndSwap replaces a live record only at the expected revision.
criteria.notes: Mismatch evidence includes stable current revisions.

criteria.description: DeleteIfRevision deletes a live record only at the expected revision.
criteria.notes: Mismatch, absence, and expiry cases are covered.

criteria.description: AtomicBatch evaluates one pre-state and applies all distinct-key mutations at one revision or none.
criteria.notes: Atomic rejection and shared-revision success paths passed.

criteria.description: Successful commits receive monotonic database-wide revisions and batches share one revision.
criteria.evidence: go test ./internal/engine ./internal/persist ./tests/crash -count=1; approved WP02/WP03/WP08 review evidence
criteria.notes: Recovery accepts durably burned gaps while rejecting reuse or regression.

criteria.description: Memory acknowledgement occurs after ordered RAM visibility and is explicitly non-durable.
criteria.notes: Crash evidence distinguishes memory, durable, and unacknowledged outcomes.

criteria.description: Durable acknowledgement occurs only after the commit and all earlier commits have synced.
criteria.notes: Fault-sensitive sync observation and response-loss reconciliation passed.

criteria.description: Recovery loads the newest valid snapshot and complete WAL records, tolerating only an incomplete tail.
criteria.notes: CRC, truncation, corruption, version, and identity boundaries passed.

criteria.description: Snapshots are checksummed and atomically installed before WAL history is retired.
criteria.notes: Rename, parent-directory sync, and authority-swap fault seams passed.

criteria.description: ScanPrefix returns bounded sorted pages at an observed revision and rejects stale continuation.
criteria.notes: Ordering, expiry exclusion, cursor integrity, and page bounds passed.

criteria.description: Watch resumes after an exclusive revision, then streams live events with compaction and lag errors.
criteria.notes: Registration, replay/live ordering, lag, cancellation, and bounded retention passed under race.

criteria.description: Expired records are logically absent everywhere and physical cleanup is a serialized commit.
criteria.notes: Read, condition, scan, watch, restart, and cleanup semantics passed.

criteria.description: Exactly one owner holds a database directory and serves through an owner-only Unix socket.
criteria.evidence: go test ./internal/owner ./internal/server ./tests/crash -count=1; release manifest NFR-009 evidence
criteria.notes: Released-lock, directory and socket-parent replacement, mode, and cleanup probes passed.

criteria.description: The Unix socket uses bounded versioned frames with stable operation and error codes.
criteria.notes: Golden bytes and strict canonical decoders passed.

criteria.description: gapctl provides non-interactive versioned JSON for all data and administrative operations.
criteria.notes: Help, schema, output limits, request correlation, and error guidance passed.

criteria.description: Operators can inspect status, health, statistics, configuration, and offline verification.
criteria.notes: Healthy, degraded, corrupt, online, and offline inspection paths passed.

criteria.description: State-changing snapshot, compaction, and recovery require identity and/or revision preconditions.
criteria.evidence: go test ./internal/admin ./internal/persist ./tests/contract/modelops -count=1; approved WP05 review evidence
criteria.notes: Wrong identity, stale revision, authority replacement, and replay cases fail closed.

criteria.description: Recovery detects damage, proposes non-mutating steps, and changes files only on explicit apply.
criteria.notes: Proposal/apply separation and bounded structured results passed.

criteria.description: Startup recovery and state-changing administration emit bounded structured audit records.
criteria.evidence: go test ./internal/admin ./internal/owner ./tests/contract/modelops -count=1; approved WP05/WP07 review evidence
criteria.notes: Database identity, revisions, outcome, stable error, and safe-action fields passed.

criteria.description: Backup produces and verifies a self-consistent image from a durable revision before success.
criteria.evidence: go test ./internal/persist ./internal/admin ./tests/crash -count=1; approved WP05/WP08 review evidence
criteria.notes: Writer barrier, bounded copy, verification, authority swaps, and failure cleanup passed.

criteria.description: Caller request IDs are echoed consistently and retry safety is documented per operation.
criteria.evidence: go test ./internal/protocol ./cmd/gapctl ./tests/contract/cli -count=1; approved WP01/WP07 review evidence
criteria.notes: Valid control characters, malformed or ambiguous IDs, unary/watch parity, and JSON-line integrity passed.
